description: Example only. A payments team that tightens a few limits for checkout and adds one rule of its own.

overrides.reason: Checkout steps should feel instant on slow devices.
Money actions go in a menu, so a stray click on a row costs less.
The payments screens use an 8px grid everywhere and we want drift to show up.

overrides.text: Money amounts use tabular numerals and always show the currency.
overrides.reason: Columns of amounts must line up, and an amount with no currency is ambiguous.
